const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /workspace/build_oof.py
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Build cross-fitted probability and test-prediction artifacts."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+import time
+import warnings
+
+import numpy as np
+import pandas as pd
+from scipy.special import softmax
+from sklearn.ensemble import ExtraTreesClassifier
+from sklearn.metrics import classification_report, f1_score
+from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
+from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
+from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder, StandardScaler
+from sklearn.svm import SVC
+
+from model_lab import engineered_features, SEED
+
+
+ARTIFACTS = Path("/workspace/artifacts")
+
+
+def class_weights(y: np.ndarray, alpha: float) -> dict[int, float]:
+    counts = np.bincount(y)
+    balanced = len(y) / len(counts) / counts
+    return {i: float(balanced[i] ** alpha) for i in range(len(counts))}
+
+
+def make_model(spec: str, y: np.ndarray):
+    kind, alpha_text, variant = (spec.split("_") + ["base"])[:3]
+    alpha = float(alpha_text[1:])
+    weights = class_weights(y, alpha)
+    if kind == "lgb":
+        from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
+        params = dict(
+            n_estimators=900, learning_rate=.03, num_leaves=31,
+            min_child_samples=12, subsample=.85, colsample_bytree=.85,
+            reg_lambda=1.0, class_weight=weights, random_state=SEED,
+            n_jobs=-1, verbosity=-1,
+        )
+        if variant == "small":
+            params.update(num_leaves=15, min_child_samples=20, reg_lambda=2.0)
+        elif variant == "large":
+            params.update(num_leaves=63, min_child_samples=8, reg_lambda=.5)
+        return LGBMClassifier(**params)
+    if kind == "cat":
+        from catboost import CatBoostClassifier
+        return CatBoostClassifier(
+            iterations=900, depth=7, learning_rate=.05,
+            loss_function="MultiClass", class_weights=list(weights.values()),
+            l2_leaf_reg=5, random_seed=SEED, verbose=False, thread_count=-1,
+        )
+    if kind == "et":
+        return ExtraTreesClassifier(
+            n_estimators=1000, max_features=1.0, min_samples_leaf=1,
+            class_weight=weights, n_jobs=-1, random_state=SEED,
+        )
+    if kind == "svc":
+        # alpha is encoded in the custom per-row weights during fit below only
+        return make_pipeline(
+            StandardScaler(),
+            SVC(C=3 if variant == "c3" else 10, gamma="scale", class_weight=weights,
+                cache_size=3000, decision_function_shape="ovr"),
+        )
+    raise ValueError(spec)
+
+
+def scores(model, x):
+    if hasattr(model, "predict_proba"):
+        return model.predict_proba(x)
+    decision = model.decision_function(x)
+    return softmax(decision * 3.0, axis=1)
+
+
+def build(spec: str, x: np.ndarray, xt: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray,
+          labels: np.ndarray, folds: int):
+    splitter = StratifiedKFold(folds, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
+    oof = np.zeros((len(y), len(labels)), dtype=np.float64)
+    test_folds = np.zeros((folds, len(xt), len(labels)), dtype=np.float64)
+    start = time.time()
+    for fold, (fit_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(splitter.split(x, y)):
+        model = make_model(spec, y[fit_idx])
+        model.fit(x[fit_idx], y[fit_idx])
+        oof[val_idx] = scores(model, x[val_idx])
+        test_folds[fold] = scores(model, xt)
+        pred = oof[val_idx].argmax(1)
+        print(spec, "fold", fold + 1,
+              "macro", f"{f1_score(y[val_idx], pred, average='macro'):.5f}",
+              "acc", f"{np.mean(y[val_idx] == pred):.5f}", flush=True)
+    pred = oof.argmax(1)
+    test_prob = test_folds.mean(0)
+    test_pred = test_prob.argmax(1)
+    print("\n", spec, "OOF macro", f1_score(y, pred, average="macro"),
+          "accuracy", np.mean(y == pred), "seconds", time.time() - start)
+    print(classification_report(y, pred, target_names=labels, digits=4, zero_division=0))
+    print("test", Counter(labels[test_pred]),
+          "confidence", np.quantile(test_prob.max(1), [0, .1, .5, .9, 1]), flush=True)
+    np.savez_compressed(
+        ARTIFACTS / f"{spec}.npz", oof=oof, test_folds=test_folds,
+        test_prob=test_prob, y=y, labels=labels,
+    )
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("specs", nargs="+")
+    parser.add_argument("--folds", type=int, default=5)
+    parser.add_argument("--engineered", action="store_true")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
+    ARTIFACTS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    train = pd.read_csv("/workspace/train.csv")
+    test = pd.read_csv("/workspace/test.csv")
+    raw_cols = list(test.columns[1:])
+    if args.engineered:
+        combined = pd.concat([train.drop(columns="label"), test], ignore_index=True)
+        feats = engineered_features(combined, raw_cols).to_numpy()
+        x, xt = feats[:len(train)], feats[len(train):]
+    else:
+        x, xt = train[raw_cols].to_numpy(), test[raw_cols].to_numpy()
+    encoder = LabelEncoder().fit(train.label)
+    y = encoder.transform(train.label)
+    for spec in args.specs:
+        name = f"{spec}_eng" if args.engineered else spec
+        build(name, x, xt, y, encoder.classes_, args.folds)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";

const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /workspace/clean_models.py
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Fit label-cleaning variants for the reviewed UCI holdout."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+import time
+import warnings
+
+import numpy as np
+import pandas as pd
+from cleanlab.filter import find_label_issues
+from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
+from catboost import CatBoostClassifier
+from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
+
+from model_lab import engineered_features, SEED
+
+
+def weights(y, alpha):
+    count = np.bincount(y, minlength=6)
+    base = len(y) / 6 / count
+    return {i: float(base[i] ** alpha) for i in range(6)}
+
+
+def fit_pair(x_raw, xt_raw, x_eng, xt_eng, y, keep, replacement, quality):
+    yy = y.copy()
+    if replacement is not None:
+        yy[replacement[0]] = replacement[1]
+    idx = np.flatnonzero(keep)
+    wl = weights(yy[idx], 1.3)
+    lgb = LGBMClassifier(
+        n_estimators=850, learning_rate=.03, num_leaves=15,
+        min_child_samples=20, subsample=.85, colsample_bytree=.85,
+        reg_lambda=2.0, class_weight=wl, random_state=SEED,
+        n_jobs=-1, verbosity=-1,
+    )
+    wc = weights(yy[idx], .5)
+    cat = CatBoostClassifier(
+        iterations=850, depth=7, learning_rate=.05, loss_function="MultiClass",
+        class_weights=list(wc.values()), l2_leaf_reg=5, random_seed=SEED,
+        verbose=False, thread_count=-1,
+    )
+    sample_weight = quality[idx] if quality is not None else None
+    lgb.fit(x_eng[idx], yy[idx], sample_weight=sample_weight)
+    cat.fit(x_raw[idx], yy[idx], sample_weight=sample_weight)
+    return .5 * lgb.predict_proba(xt_eng) + .5 * cat.predict_proba(xt_raw)
+
+
+def main():
+    warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
+    root = Path("/workspace")
+    art = root / "artifacts"
+    train = pd.read_csv(root / "train.csv")
+    test = pd.read_csv(root / "test.csv")
+    raw_cols = list(test.columns[1:])
+    x_raw, xt_raw = train[raw_cols].to_numpy(), test[raw_cols].to_numpy()
+    combined = pd.concat([train.drop(columns="label"), test], ignore_index=True)
+    z = engineered_features(combined, raw_cols).to_numpy()
+    x_eng, xt_eng = z[:len(train)], z[len(train):]
+    encoder = LabelEncoder().fit(train.label)
+    y = encoder.transform(train.label)
+    a = dict(np.load(art / "cat_a0.5.npz", allow_pickle=True))
+    b = dict(np.load(art / "lgb_a1.3_small_eng.npz", allow_pickle=True))
+    p = .5 * a["oof"] + .5 * b["oof"]
+    pred = p.argmax(1)
+    conf = p.max(1)
+    disagree = pred != y
+    cl57 = find_label_issues(y, p, filter_by="both", return_indices_ranked_by="self_confidence")
+    cl87 = find_label_issues(y, p, filter_by="prune_by_noise_rate", return_indices_ranked_by="self_confidence")
+    common = np.isin(y, [0, 1, 3])
+    variants = {
+        "base": (np.ones(len(y), bool), None, None),
+        "drop_cl57": (~np.isin(np.arange(len(y)), cl57), None, None),
+        "drop_cl87": (~np.isin(np.arange(len(y)), cl87), None, None),
+        "drop_conf08": (~(disagree & (conf >= .8)), None, None),
+        "drop_conf08_common": (~(disagree & (conf >= .8) & common), None, None),
+        "drop_all_disagree": (~disagree, None, None),
+        "relabel_cl57": (np.ones(len(y), bool), (cl57, pred[cl57]), None),
+        "relabel_conf09": (np.ones(len(y), bool), (np.flatnonzero(disagree & (conf >= .9)), pred[disagree & (conf >= .9)]), None),
+        "relabel_conf08": (np.ones(len(y), bool), (np.flatnonzero(disagree & (conf >= .8)), pred[disagree & (conf >= .8)]), None),
+        "relabel_conf08_common": (np.ones(len(y), bool), (np.flatnonzero(disagree & (conf >= .8) & common), pred[disagree & (conf >= .8) & common]), None),
+        "relabel_all_disagree": (np.ones(len(y), bool), (np.flatnonzero(disagree), pred[disagree]), None),
+        "soft_quality": (np.ones(len(y), bool), None, np.clip(p[np.arange(len(y)), y] / .5, .1, 1.0)),
+    }
+    names, probs = [], []
+    for name, (keep, replacement, quality) in variants.items():
+        start = time.time()
+        prob = fit_pair(x_raw, xt_raw, x_eng, xt_eng, y, keep, replacement, quality)
+        names.append(name)
+        probs.append(prob)
+        changed = 0 if replacement is None else len(replacement[0])
+        print(name, "kept", keep.sum(), "relabeled", changed,
+              "test", Counter(encoder.classes_[prob.argmax(1)]),
+              "seconds", round(time.time() - start, 1), flush=True)
+    np.savez_compressed(art / "clean_candidates.npz", names=np.array(names), probs=np.array(probs), labels=encoder.classes_)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
